newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle moderate at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle moderate at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry and demand fairly good early, light later.

Sales confirmed on 15,000 slaughter steers and 9,900 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 78,100 head confirmed including 14,700 head or about 17 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1080-1260 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 970-1160 lbs 69.00,
